build_detection_block: build a DetectionBlock with specified in_channels and out_channels for YOLO neck feature extraction
build_yolov3_neck: build a YOLOV3Neck with num_scales, in_channels, and out_channels lists for multi-scale detection
run_detection_block_forward: run the DetectionBlock forward pass on a tensor to extract features through conv layers
run_yolov3_neck_forward: run the YOLOV3Neck forward pass on multi-scale feature tensors to get detection outputs
review_yolov3_neck_forward: review the YOLOV3Neck forward method that processes features from high-level to low-level with upsampling
